component.name: Newskite
component.summary: Download files from Usenet using NZB files

description.p: Newskite is a desktop Usenet download client. Give it an NZB file and it fetches the binary articles from your news server over TLS, decodes them and writes the original files to disk, then verifies, repairs and extracts them with built-in code; no external tools are needed.

ul.li: Download queue with precise progress that resumes after a restart
Multiple servers with priorities, per-server connection counts and a connection test
Built-in PAR2 verify and repair plus RAR, 7z and ZIP extraction, including split and spanned volumes and passwords
Watch folder, speed limit, scheduler window and optional shutdown when done
Live throughput graph, activity log and bookmarks
The innerpulse carbon look, a warm ink and a paper theme, or the desktop light or dark color scheme
Headless command-line mode that drives the same queue engine

description.p: Newskite does not include a Usenet server subscription or a search indexer. Server passwords are stored unencrypted in the local database.

A new look on Linux and Windows: the innerpulse carbon theme, with a brushed plate, keys of smoked glass, frosted sheets, toasts and menus, and a seven-segment display of the download speed in the sidebar. A warm ink theme joins paper, and following the desktop color scheme stays available in Settings. The app icons are redrawn on the carbon ground.

Post-processing needs no external programs: PAR2 repair and RAR, 7z and zip extraction, including split zip sets, are built in. Repair, verification and downloading are faster, and the interface is redesigned with smoother motion and readable contrast in every theme.
First release: NZB import, TLS downloads, queue, post-processing and headless mode.
